recipes.name: Mexican Bean Salad
ingredients_raw: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (15 ounce) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 (15 ounce) can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
1 (10 ounce) package frozen corn kernels, thawed
0.5 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste
1 dash hot pepper sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Combine beans, bell peppers, corn, and red onion in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, cilantro, lime juice, lemon juice, garlic, sugar, salt, cumin, and black pepper together in a small bowl. Season with chili powder and hot sauce.
Pour dressing over bean mixture and toss well. Refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour. Serve cold.

raw_recipe.headline: Mexican Bean Salad
raw_recipe.description: This colorful Mexican bean salad with 3 types of canned beans, corn, crunchy bell peppers, and south-of-the-border flavors make it a crowd-pleaser.

video.description: This recipe video showcases a wonderfully versatile Mexican-style bean salad. This handy dish can serve as a fresh and tasty side dish for almost any meal, and it's especially useful for a picnic or outdoor party.
video.name: How to Make Mexican Bean Salad

review.reviewBody:
I followed this recipe almost exactly (something new for me) and it was ... wow ... incredible. I served it at a party, and got rave reviews -- two people even asked for the recipe!

Based on the feedback of others, I started out with only 1 tbl of sugar, then added more to taste. The end result was probably close to 2 tbl. I also added a bit of lemon and lime zest to the dressing.

Warning: I think this recipe ends up closer to 10 servings. I had to make it in my huge wooden salad bowl, because even my largest mixing bowl wasn't adequate.

By the way, this is even better after a few days, when the flavors have time to fully meld. I usually make this at least two days ahead of time.
The best bean salad I have made. I halved the oil, vinegar and sugar. Thank goodness I read the post. This amount suited the recipe just fine. Thanks

So delicious. I have made this salad over and over again with awesome results each time. I usually cut the sugar in half. I like to add powdered garlic, and extra cilantro. I use Great White Northern beans instead of Cannelini. Red onions add a pretty color. We make this all the time! I am confused by the raters that say there is too much dressing... I think the amount is right on. Although I do use a can of corn instead of frozen... maybe the extra liquid comes from the frozen corn. Sometimes I add a can of chopped tomatoes. You can add any veggies you like, the salad doesn't care. I would give this more stars if I could.

Very yummy! I made it just as written except left out the hot pepper sauce. Served over a bed of Romaine with the option of crushed tortilla chips and sour cream on top. Everyone at the party loved it, too.

Excellent! I took the suggestions of a few reviewers. I marinated the beans in the dressing 2 days before serving. The day before serving I added the remaining ingredients and on the serving day I added 2 diced avocados. We served it with chips on the side and everyone loved it!

Best bean salad ever. Only change I made was to cut salt to 1 tsp and I added an extra tbsp. of sugar to counteract the acidity of the lime, lemon and vinegar. Gets better every day. If you feel there’s too much dressing, as I read in several reviews, pour some out and marinate chicken or pork in it. You won’t be disappointed

I wanted a side dish for a large group, and this one really hit the mark; have made it three times since. Based on other reviewers I did make a few changes. I marinated the beans in the dressing 1-2 nights before adding the fresh veggies and the corn. I used frozen Roasted Corn one time, and that was better than regular. Other additions/changes included a whole diced Jalapeno, omitted sugar, decreased olive oil and vinegar by 30-50%, and added extra Cumin and hot sauce. Family members all asked for the recipe. They really liked it as a dip and ate it up! Making it again this week for just the hubby and I.

I don’t like cooking at all. And let me tell you you that - without exaggeration - I basically eat this every day. I eat it with brown rice - it's a complete protein then. The changes I do to the recipe are I only use half the oil. It's just too much in my opinion. And I do half red wine vinegar and half seasoned rice vinegar and I omit the sugar. And I use whatever 3 beans I want. Usually kidney, garbanzo, and black. I love it and I never get sick of it. Made it for my son’s wedding and it was a hit. AND-if you’re wondering about eating this often and grassiness…remarkably it doesn’t give me gas. I don’t know if it’s the vinegar that neutralizes that. The internet says that’s not the case…but for whatever reason, no problems there.
Added horseradish, black olives, green olives, carrots, celery, water chestnuts. Mexican Cowboy Caviar!
Absolutely fantastic! The only change I made was to use more cilantro and blend it with the oil & vinegar in a blender to make a green vinaigrette. Everyone raved about it.

Very colorful salad. The 1 TBL of salt is way too much salt. I threw out dressing and made another batch with only 1 tsp of salt; 1/4 cup red wine vinegar; 1/4 cup olive oil; leave rest of spices as stated in recipe. Better to leave salad overnight in refrigerator to marinate.
We all love it!
Absolute toddler favorite
served at a party, so good!
Very good. Nice variation from your typical bean salad.
I substituted a can of Ro-tel with Chili’s instead of white beans & ranch for pinto beans. I would drained the tomatoes & doubled the dressing ingredients for more flavor. Still, very good!
Followed recipe. Five stars plus

This is so good!! I love making it thenight before and taking it to the beach with us. But we love it for all kinds of occasions. Easy and yummy!! And add other things to make it your own. Very versatile 👌

I have made this recipe exactly as directed on 2 occasions. The only thing I would try next time is to exchange the cannellini beans for chicken peas because they are mushy and fragile and start to mash down right away.
Made this recipe exactly as is and it was perfect. We enjoyed it over a few days.
